book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Bolla Wottadarata Qidhe
Hessafe guye Philaxoosi Yesusa efidi garafissides.
Wottadaratikka agunththa zawude xaaxidi Yesusa hu7en woththida; zo7o kaabbaka mayzida.
Izakko shiiqi shiiqidi, «Ayhuda kawo saro! saro!» gi giidi iza shagalan baqqida.
Philaxoosi qasseka kare kessidi, «Hekko ta iza bolla aykko moorokka demmonttayssa intte erana mala ta iza inttes haa kare kessana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Yesusi agunththa zawude hu7en woththi ekkidi zo7o kaabba may7idi kare kezides. Philaxoosikka isttas, «Hekko addezi hayssich!» gides.
Qeeseta halaqatinne istta ashkarati Yesusa be7idi, «Ne iza kaqqa! Kaqqa!» gishe waassida. Philaxoosi qasse, «Tani ta baggara iza bolla issi moorokka demmabeekke; koykko intte efidi kaqqite» gides.
Ayhuda asati qasse, «Nuus wogay dees; hayssi addezi bana Xoossa naa giza gishshas nu woga mala izas hayqoy bessees» gida.
Philaxoosi hessa istti gizayssa siyidi daro babbides.
Gede gibbe gelidi Yesusa, «Ne awappe yadii?» gi oychchides. Yesusi qasse izas ay zaarokka immibeenna.
Hessa gishshas Philaxoosi, «Ne taas yootikkii? Ta nena kaqqanaas woykko birsha yeddanaas godateththi taas dizayssa erkkii?» gides.
Yesusikka izas zaaridi, «Sheney nees Xoossafe imettonttaako nees ta bolla ay godateththika deennashin; gido attiin tana nees aaththi immidaade bolla gita nagaray dees» gides.
Yesusa Bolla Pirdettida Hayqo Pirda

Philaxoosi hessa Yesusa haasaya siyidaappe guye iza birshi yeddana koyides shin Ayhudatas babbida gishshas istti, «Ne hayssa addeza birshiko Oroome Kawo Qeesaare bagga gidakka; gaasoykka bana barkka kawoththizaadey wuri Qeesaares morkke» gishe wurikka waassida.
Philaxoosi hessa siyida mala Yesusa kare kessidi, «Lochcha shuch» geetettizason pirda womboran uttides. He pirdasoy Ayhudata qaalara, «Gabata» geetettees.
He wode gadey asi Paaziga ba7aales giigettiza gallassa. Wodeykka gallassafe usuppun saate mala gidides; he wode Philaxoosi Ayhudata, «Hekko intte kawoy hayssich!» gides.
Gido attiin istti qasse, «Gede digga! Gede digga! Kaqqa!» gishe waassida. Philaxoosikka, «Ta intte kawo kaqqoo?» gides. Qeeseta halaqati zaaridi, «Nuus Qeesaareppe hara kawoy deenna» gida.
Hessafe simmidi Philaxoosi Yesusa kaqqana mala isttas aaththi immides. Isttika Yesusa oykki ekki efida.
Yesusa Kaqeteth
Hessafe guye Yesusi ba kaqettana masqaleza tookkidi, «Asa hu7e guugge» geetettizaso kezides. He sohoy Ayhudata qaalara, «Golgota» geetettees.
Iza heen kaqqida. Yesusa giddo gelththidi hara nam7u asata izaththo hadirsaranne ushachchara kaqqida.
Philaxoosi, «Naazirete Yesusi Ayhudata kawo» giza qaala xaafidi iza masqale bolla izas hu7esora qaaphides.
Yesusi kaqettidasoy katamaas mata gidida gishshas daro Ayhuda asay Philaxoosi xaafidayssa nababides; xaafettidayssika Ayhudata qaalara, Laatine qaalaranne Girike qaalara.
Ayhudata qeeseta halaqati Philaxoosa, «Ne iza Ayhudata kawo» gaada xaafoppa. Gido attiin, « ‹Hayssi addezi bana ta Ayhudata kawo› gides gaada xaafa» gida.
Philaxoosi qasse, «Ta xaafidayssa xaafadis» gides.

Wottadarati Yesusa kaqqidaappe guye iza may7oza ekkidi wottadarata issaa issaa gakkana mala oyddu kessi shaakereththida. Garsara may7iza may7ozakka hessaththo shaakereththida. Gido attiin garsara may7iza may7ozi sikettontta pudeppe duge gakkanaas coo yeda dees.
Hessa gishshas wottadarati ba giddon, «Gishan oona gakkanaakko erana mala iza bolla saama yeggana attiin daakkoko» gida; hessika haniday kase,

content.text: tani bollara may7iza may7oza bolla saama yeggida»

content: geetettida Geeshsha maxaafa qaalay polettana malassa. Wottadaratikka hessa ooththida.
Yesusa masqale achchan iza aayeyanne aayey michcheya Qaliyopha machcha Maaramanne Magdale geetettizasoppe yida Maarama heen eqqida.
Yesusi ba aayeyonne izi siiqiza iza kaallizayssi ba achchan eqqidayta be7idi ba aayeyo, «Aayee! Ne naaza hessa beya» gides.
Hessafe kaaleththidi bana kaallizayssa, «Ne aayo hinno beya» gides. Hinno he saateyppe simmiin iza kaallizayssi aayeyo baso efides.
Yesusa Hayqo
Hessafe guye Yesusi ha7i wurikka polettidayssa eridi Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettidayssi polettana mala, «Tana saamees» gides.

Heen caala phanqida ushshi kumi uttida issi xaaro malay dees. Hessa gishshas heen dizayti he caala ushshaa zandza misatiza safinege geetettizayssara hisophphe geetettiza miththa xeeran qaaphidi iza doonaakko shiishshida.
Yesusi he caala ushshaa xunxi xeellidi, «Polettides!» gides. Ba hu7e duge ziqqisidi shemppo kezides.

Hessafe guye Ayhudata daannati kaqettida asata meqeth wodirappe menththidi istti iza masqale bollafe woththana mala Philaxoosa woossida. Istti hessa ooththiday Ayhudati sambatas giigettiza gallas gidida gishshassinne he sambataykka daro gita ba7aale gidida gishshas Sambata gallas ahay masqale bolla gam7ontta mala koyida gishshassa.
Hessa gishshas wottadarati biidi Yesusara kaqettida asata meqeth wodirappe wodirappe menththida.
Istti Yesusaakko biin izi kaseti hayqqidayssa be7idi iza wodira meqeth menththibeettenna.
Gido attiin wottadarata giddofe issaadey toorara iza millen caddiin heerakka suuththinne haaththi gukkides.
Hessa be7idaadey intte izan ammanana mala markkattides; iza markkateththika tuma. Izi yootizaykka tumu gididayssa izi erees.
Hessika haniday, «Iza meqeththafe issinakka meqquku» geetettida Geeshsha maxaafa qaalay polettanaassa.
Qasseka Geeshsha Maxaafan harason, «Istti bana caddidaade beyana» gees.
Yesusa Moogeteth

Ayhudata daannata babbidi qotan Yesusa kaalliza Armatiyase geetettizasoppe yida Yooseefey Yesusa aha ekkanaas Philaxoosa woossiin Philaxoosikka izas ero gides. Hessa gishshas Yooseefey biidi Yesusa aha ekkides.
Kase Yesusaakko qamara yida Niqodimoosikka bagga kilo gidiza karbbenne godare uuththara walakettida shitto ekki yides.
He nam7u asati Yesusa ahaza ekkidi Ayhudati ahaa xaaxiza mala shitto puukkidi lee7e may7ora xaaxida.
Yesusi kaqettidasohon issi atakiltesoy dees. He atakiltezason oonikka moogettontta ooraththa duufoy dees.
Ayhudata sambatas giigettiza gallas gidida gishshassinne duufoykka matan diza gishshas Yesusa aha heen moogida.
